requirements: We are a distributed team, stretching from our offices in Dublin and NYC to other locations in Europe, the US, and Canada. Every now and then, we all meet in one place for project kickoffs, workshops, and team events
5+ years of product management experience with a track record of shipping developer-facing tools, integrations, SDKs, or APIs

Familiarity with adjacent ML and Data Science concepts and tooling (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, common ML frameworks) and an understanding of how AI applications are built, deployed, and monitored in production

Comfort with the unique challenges of AI product development (model uncertainty, evaluation difficulty, longer or non-linear development cycles) and the ability to set realistic expectations with stakeholders accordingly
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product direction for a wide range of audiences, from individual developers to executive stakeholders
Ability to distill customer use cases into comprehensive business cases and execute on them
